name: mask-studio
description: Mask Studio — standalone testbed for the phosmith megashader masking engine with on-device AI

scripts.dev: bun run build.mjs && bun run serve.mjs
scripts.setup:ort: mkdir -p ort && cp ../phosmith/node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded*.mjs ort/ && cp ../phosmith/node_modules/onnxruntime-web/dist/ort-wasm-simd-threaded*.wasm ort/ && echo 'ORT WASM files copied to ort/'
